name: Corfu in a day
description_md:
Corfu in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in GR. The distance of the route is 3.4 km and the walking time is about 7.3 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This path is a waymarked hiking route. It covers a distance of 3.4 km. The walking time is about 7.3 hours according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
